messages:
anne-docs: Hey team — PR #8424 (streaming SDK examples + migration notes) is blocked by two things: the docs preview linkcheck fails for an internal migration link, and the runtime reported the API error text doesn’t match the snippet in the docs. Can someone help?

sam-devex: @anne-docs can you paste the failing link and the runtime error?

anne-docs: Linkcheck error: \'/guides/migrate-to-v2#streaming\' 404 in preview build. I used relative link to the new migration page.

anne-docs: Runtime error (from prod-staging) when running JS streaming snippet: 

```
Error: Unexpected message: {"error":"invalid_stream_init","message":"init payload missing role"}
```

anne-docs: But the docs snippet shows init payload without explicit role (we were following older examples).

mike-runtime: Hmm — runtime changed to require role on the init payload for streaming after last patch. We updated the server but docs not yet. That would explain mismatch.

li-engineering: We should decide whether to relax the runtime or update docs. Which is the right policy? Backwards-compat is preferred for minor breakingness.

mike-runtime: We debated it, but the role enforcement prevents ambiguous assistant/system messages in multi-party streams. It's intentional. We can add a compatibility toggle but it will take a small rollout.

jen-qa: For the PR timeline: docs preview is failing linkcheck first. I can patch the link to absolute /guides/migrate-to-v2/streaming if that unblocks CI.

sam-devex: @jen-qa go ahead and push that link fix — docs preview is blocking the merge. For the runtime error we should update the JS/Python snippets to include role in init payload and add a short note: "runtime now requires role field on stream init; runtime will relax in vX.Y or provide toggle".

anne-docs: Draft snippet update: 

```js
// stream init
ws.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'init', role: 'user', content: '...'}));
```

Is that what you expect @mike-runtime?

mike-runtime: Yes. Add one more example showing explicit system message: 

```js
ws.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'init', role: 'system', content: 'You are a summarizer.'}));
```

mike-runtime: Also add a short note about token accounting: streaming vs non-streaming count is identical; only init vs message framing differs.

li-engineering: Good catch on token accounting — docs need to be clear because customers asked about cost for streaming.

anne-docs: I'll update snippets and add a migration note. @jen-qa please fix the link in the PR to an absolute path so preview passes.

jen-qa: On it. Pushing small link tweak now.

ci-bot: docs-preview: run started for PR #8424 — step: linkcheck.

ci-bot: docs-preview: linkcheck passed.

anne-docs: Cool. Next: can runtime team commit to a timeline for the compatibility toggle? We might add a short callout: "Behavior enforced as of 2026-04-01; toggle coming soon".

mike-runtime: We can expose a compatibility flag in the next minor (2 weeks). I'll open an eng issue and link it in the docs. Ticket: ENG-3129 (will add to PR comment).

sam-devex: That sounds reasonable. For reviewers: @li-engineering are you ok approving once snippets + migration note + ENG-3129 link are in the PR?

li-engineering: Yes — as long as we include the runtime ticket and explicit example showing system/user roles. Also mention streaming init error code: "invalid_stream_init".

anne-docs: Great — I updated the PR with snippet changes, added migration paragraph, and linked ENG-3129. Ready for review.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build succeeded for PR #8424 — preview URL: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/pr-8424/ — linkcheck green.

li-engineering: Reviewing now. Quick nit: add a tiny note about SDK helpers that wrap role injection for convenience.

anne-docs: Will add that line. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jen-qa: Verified preview renders examples and migration note.

li-engineering: Approved.

sam-devex: Approved from devex side.

anne-docs: Merging after CI green. Thanks everyone!

ci-bot: pr-merge-bot: merge queued for PR #8424 (passing checks).

ci-bot: pr-merge-bot: merged PR #8424 at 1848123720.
